newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hikari Tsushin to issue 700,000 new shares.
newsitem.headline: Hikari Tsushin to issue 700,000 new shares.

text.p: Telecommunications firm Hikari Tsushin said on Thursday it would issue 700,000 shares worth 11.17 billion yen on the over-the-counter market.
It said the price of the new shares had not been set but payment would be due on October 11.
Of the funds raised through the new stock issue, 9.37 billion yen would be used as capital for expanding its retail stores and 1.1 billion yen to pay back loans.
The remaining 700 million yen would be used for investment in communications systems, it said.
